notes.title: Minor Patch fix
notes.notes: Fixed one edge case related to boss retries.

notes.title: Balanace Update and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Balance Changes 
-Stage 1 boss (MOMO) has been altered to be less aggressive , attacks related to her flower are mostly removed and she provides a bigger window of time to be hit by players. She also no longer shifts position at the end of an attack loop and remains above the water for the duration of the fight. 

-Bosses can now be re challenged immediately if you get a game over to one without having to replay stages again. Due to how stages are programmed, the background /environment that appears along with the boss will not be displayed  with the boss for the time being. This limitation will be fixed in a future update.
 
Bug fixes 
Controller changes / detection are now recognised when unplugging  a controller during the gameplay. Note this may cause a error in which the pause screen is shown with no text the first time this is attempted (or if it's attempted as soon as a stage starts , we are currently working on fixing this.
